minv_sk_statistika.publisher: Ministerstvo vnútra Slovenskej republiky (Prezídium Policajného zboru data; 'Zdroj Ministerstvo vnútra SR')
minv_sk_statistika.file_urls: one file per year, e.g. https://www.minv.sk/swift_data/source/policia/statistiky_2024/12_december/2statistika_podla_nazvov_TC_2_31.12.2024.xml ; 1997-2008 under /swift_data/source/policia/statistiky/rok_YYYY/ ; full list of the 29 URLs used is in problems.md
minv_sk_statistika.notes: Each workbook has one worksheet for the Slovak Republic (SR) and one per kraj (BL Bratislavský, TT Trnavský, TN Trenčiansky, NR Nitriansky, ZA Žilinský, BB Banskobystrický, PO Prešovský, KE Košický) plus police bodies outside the kraj structure (VP Vojenská polícia, ZV Zbor väzenskej a justičnej stráže, ZP Železničná polícia in early years, CR Colné riaditeľstvo). Every row whose label contains 'vražd' (murder sub-types by motive/paragraph) or 'zabitie' (manslaughter, § 147-148) was extracted with every column: offences detected (Zistené), cleared (Objasnené), clearance %, damage, later cleared, alcohol/drug influence, juvenile/minor offenders, and the persons section (Celkom osôb etc.). 'samovražda' (suicide) rows were excluded. Parsed with python xml.etree; script saved as extract_script.py in this folder.

# Slovakia (SVK) - sub-national homicide

## What was found
Ministerstvo vnútra SR publishes monthly-cumulative crime statistics 1997-2026 at https://www.minv.sk/?statistika-kriminality-v-slovenskej-republike-xml (and a CSV version at ?statistika-kriminality-v-slovenskej-republike-csv). The CSV files contain only the Slovak Republic sheet; the XML (Excel SpreadsheetML) files contain one worksheet per kraj (8 regions) plus country and special police bodies. I used the year-end file (1.1.-31.12.) of table 2 "podľa názvov trestných činov" for each year 1997-2025 (29 files). 2026 is only partial (monthly to date) and was not used.

## Caveats
- Murder is published only by sub-type (by motive or paragraph: úkladné § 144, lúpežné, sexuálne, motivated by personal relations, business relations, newborn child, contract killing, racial motive, other) plus "zabitie" (manslaughter § 147-148 from 2006 Criminal Code). No murder total row is given; rows.csv keeps each sub-type. A total would be the sum of the "vraždy" rows (not added, to avoid inventing a figure).
- Paragraph numbers change in 2006: § 219 under the old Criminal Code 140/1961 Zb., § 144-145 under the new code 300/2005. "zabitie" appears only from the new code.
- Kraj worksheets omit sub-type rows that are zero, so a missing row in a year means the kraj table did not list it (most likely 0, but this is not stated).
- Kraj = police territorial unit (Krajské riaditeľstvo PZ). VP, ZV, ZP, CR are police bodies with nationwide competence, kept with level "other police body".
- Damage values are in thousand SKK up to 2008 and thousand EUR from 2009 (as headed in each file).
- No okres (district) breakdown was found in these files.

## Not reached
- ŠÚ SR DATAcube (datacube.statistics.sk): the data service URL returned only a redirect page ("DATAcube. – presmerovanie"); not followed further.
- searching stopped early (search limit reached).
